results.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
results.original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
results.overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

results.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
results.overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

results.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

results.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
results.overview: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

results.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
results.overview: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

results.title: The Runner
results.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

results.title: Mayday
results.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

results.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
results.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

results.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
results.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

results.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
results.overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

results.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
results.overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

results.title: NXT Heatwave 2026
results.overview: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

results.title: The Whisper Man
results.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

results.title: The Last Salute
results.overview: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

results.title: The Last Sunrise
results.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

results.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
results.original_title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
results.overview: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

results.title: Stamptown
results.overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

results.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
results.original_title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
results.overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

results.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
results.overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

results.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK: Rewind
results.overview: Hosted by international Drag Race aficionado Angeria Paris VanMicheals, RuPaul’s Drag Race UK: Rewind takes a hilarious trip down memory lane to revisit some of the most unforgettable moments from seven seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK and three seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK vs The World. From iconic runway looks and legendary performances to outrageous comedy, unforgettable drama and the queens who snatched the crown, celebrate the very best of Drag Race UK — before a brand-new season begins.
